announcements.headline: Exercise of Employee Options over Existing Shares
announcements.insight: Employee options were exercised. This is a minor capital action unrelated to the recent contract win or tape-out completion.

announcements.headline: New Contract Win & Completed Tape-out of ASIC
announcements.insight: EnSilica secured a new contract win and completed an ASIC tape-out. This follows earlier satellite orders and a capital raise, indicating continued operational progress.

announcements.headline: Final Results
announcements.insight: Final Results follow the July retail offer and subsequent satellite orders. Shareholders should monitor how these recent activities influence the reported financial position.

announcements.headline: Final Results
announcements.insight: Final results follow the July capital raise. Shareholders should watch for performance against the new funds.

announcements.headline: EU Space & Comms Centre of Excellence
announcements.insight: Following July fundraising and satellite orders, this announcement relates to a Centre of Excellence. Shareholders should watch for details on how this initiative supports recent commercial activities.

announcements.headline: Result of General Meeting and Total Voting Rights
Follow on Satellite Orders
announcements.insight: EnSilica has secured follow-on satellite orders. This follows the completion of its Edge AI ASIC tape-out and recent equity fundraising.

announcements.headline: Result of Retail Offer and Notice of GM
announcements.insight: Following the July equity fundraising, this result confirms the retail offer outcome. Shareholders should monitor the subsequent notice of GM for next steps.

announcements.headline: Retail Offer to raise up to £1 million
announcements.insight: Following the July proposal, this retail offer completes the oversubscribed fundraising. Shareholders should note the capital raise is now finalized.

announcements.headline: Result of oversubscribed Placing and Subscription
announcements.insight: Following the July proposal, this oversubscribed placing confirms capital raising. Proceeds likely fund the Edge AI ASIC tape-out completion announced in June.

announcements.headline: Proposed equity fundraising via ABB
announcements.insight: Proposed equity fundraising via ABB follows the Edge AI ASIC supply contract completion. This capital raise supports the recent tape-out milestone.

announcements.headline: Edge AI ASIC Supply Contract Completes Tape-Out
announcements.insight: EnSilica has completed tape-out for an Edge AI ASIC supply contract. This milestone follows its 25th anniversary in June 2026.

announcements.headline: 25th Company Anniversary
announcements.insight: This marks a corporate milestone rather than a financial event. Shareholders should monitor future filings for substantive operational updates.
